content.en_us:
How to get it :
- Crafting table (x6) : [[gv:billet_am_mix|Reactor Grade Americium Billet]].
- Crafting table (x9) : [[gv:ingot_am_mix|Reactor Grade Americium Ingot]].
- [[PUREX|PUREX]] (x9) : [[gv:pwr_fuel_depleted_bfb_am_mix|Depleted Fuel Grade Americium PWR BFB Rod]], 500 mB kerosene, 250 mB nitric acid.

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_am_mix|Reactor Grade Americium Billet]], [[gv:billet_americium_fuel|Americium Fuel Billet]], [[gv:ingot_am_mix|Reactor Grade Americium Ingot]].
